main_text.head: IDEM EIDEM NOBILISSIMO D. THOMÆ VVARTHONO.
main_text.p: PArvum, nec lepidum, nec expolitum, Do donóque libens volens libellum, Vvarthoni tibi: quem facit coruscum Virtus & pietas bonæque Musæ, Adiuncto Charitum choro decentum.
Hunc si fronte legas benignus illâ, Quâ nulli grauis, omnibúsque gratus, Phæbo digna loquens, plagæ Britannæ Charus Palladiis viris bonísque es:
O natum bene tunc meum libellum, Musarum & Charitum sinu receptum: Nam paruus licet is nec expolitus: Contendet tamen is libris libellus Multis nec breuibus nec impolitis.

page.notes: The running head is faint and partly mirrored by show-through; "EPIST. DEDIC." is a best reading [?]. The first word is a large initial P joined to "Arvum". The underlined "Quâ" in the second stanza is shown as printed without marking. The verse lines are run together within each stanza, since the line breaks are not marked.
